title: Camera terms worth knowing

body.text: Add camera directions to your prompt to control movement, like
'zoom in', 'pan left', 'aerial drone shot', 'tracking shot', 'slow motion'
. These make the clip look intentionally directed, not a still image with a slight wobble.

example: Aerial drone shot flying over snowy mountains at dawn, moving slowly forward

title: Speed and direction

body.text: Specify the speed (slow motion / time-lapse) and the direction of an object's movement to get the pacing you want. Without it, the motion may stutter or move too fast.

example: Time-lapse of clouds moving quickly across the sky over a city, sunset gradually changing color
